## ITE2eChatMemberOptions type

Options for simulating a chat member status transition update.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITE2eChatMemberOptions = ITE2eUpdateOptions & {
    oldStatus?: string;
    newStatus?: string;
    oldIsMember?: boolean;
    newIsMember?: boolean;
    botId?: number;
};
```
**References:** [ITE2eUpdateOptions](./gramstax.ite2eupdateoptions.md)

## Remarks

Used with [E2eHelper.sendChatMemberUpdate()](./gramstax.e2ehelper.sendchatmemberupdate.md) and [E2eHelper.sendMyChatMemberUpdate()](./gramstax.e2ehelper.sendmychatmemberupdate.md) to simulate membership changes.
